table_metadata.description: Employee-level HR dataset capturing demographics, job attributes, compensation, performance, satisfaction, tenure, and work patterns for 1,480 employees. Includes fields like department, job role/level, salary, stock options, performance ratings, training, travel, overtime, and attrition status. Suitable for analyzing turnover (attrition), engagement, career progression, and compensation trends.

assumptions_metadata.task_description: Score employee attrition risk monthly to prioritize retention actions and budget.

assumptions.assumption: Age must be between 18 and 65 inclusive.
At least 70% of employees are aged between 26 and 45.
Employees aged 25 or younger comprise no more than 15% of the workforce.
If Age >= 55, then AgeGroup must be '55+'.
At least 50% of employees fall into the 'Upto 5k' SalarySlab.
OverTime must be non-null for all records.
At least 65% of employees have OverTime = 'No'.
No more than 35% of employees have OverTime = 'Yes'.
JobLevel must be an integer between 1 and 5 inclusive.
At least 70% of employees are at JobLevel 1 or 2.
Employees at JobLevel 5 constitute no more than 5% of the workforce.
Employees at JobLevel 4 constitute between 5% and 10% of the workforce.

result.code:
import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Basic type normalization for safety
    numeric_cols = [
        'Age', 'MonthlyIncome', 'YearsAtCompany', 'TotalWorkingYears',
        'YearsSinceLastPromotion', 'YearsWithCurrManager', 'YearsInCurrentRole',
        'JobLevel', 'DistanceFromHome', 'JobSatisfaction', 'EnvironmentSatisfaction',
        'RelationshipSatisfaction', 'WorkLifeBalance'
    ]
    for c in numeric_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')

    # ===== Age-based features =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['Age'] >= 18) & (df['Age'] <= 65)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Piecewise age risk (younger and much older cohorts typically higher risk)
    age_risk = np.select(
        [df['Age'] <= 25, (df['Age'] >= 26) & (df['Age'] <= 35), (df['Age'] >= 36) & (df['Age'] <= 45), (df['Age'] >= 46) & (df['Age'] <= 54), df['Age'] >= 55],
        [0.30, 0.18, 0.20, 0.12, 0.22],
        default=0.18
    )

    # We will rely on AgeGroup for cohort calibration and downstream logic
    # ASSERTION_START
    cond_18_25 = (df['AgeGroup'] != '18-25') | ((df['Age'] >= 18) & (df['Age'] <= 25))
    cond_26_35 = (df['AgeGroup'] != '26-35') | ((df['Age'] >= 26) & (df['Age'] <= 35))
    cond_36_45 = (df['AgeGroup'] != '36-45') | ((df['Age'] >= 36) & (df['Age'] <= 45))
    cond_46_55 = (df['AgeGroup'] != '46-55') | ((df['Age'] >= 46) & (df['Age'] <= 55))
    cond_55_plus = (df['AgeGroup'] != '55+') | (df['Age'] >= 55)
    cond_age_to_group = (df['Age'] < 55) | (df['AgeGroup'] == '55+')
    assert cond_18_25.all() and cond_26_35.all() and cond_36_45.all() and cond_46_55.all() and cond_55_plus.all() and cond_age_to_group.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Distributional constraints used to calibrate intercept
    # ASSERTION_START
    share_mid_age = ((df['Age'] >= 26) & (df['Age'] <= 45)).mean()
    share_young = (df['Age'] <= 25).mean()
    assert share_mid_age >= 0.70
    assert share_young <= 0.15
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Cohort flags from AgeGroup (assumes mapping is correct as asserted above)
    is_mid_career = df['AgeGroup'].isin(['26-35', '36-45']).astype(int)
    is_senior_55p = (df['AgeGroup'] == '55+').astype(int)

    # ===== OverTime features =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['OverTime'].notna().all()
    assert df['OverTime'].isin(['Yes', 'No']).all()
    assert df['OverTime'].eq('No').mean() >= 0.65
    assert df['OverTime'].eq('Yes').mean() <= 0.35
    # ASSERTION_END

    overtime_flag = df['OverTime'].map({'No': 0, 'Yes': 1}).astype(int)
    overtime_risk = overtime_flag * 0.25

    # ===== Compensation and SalarySlab logic =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    c1 = (df['SalarySlab'] != 'Upto 5k') | (df['MonthlyIncome'] < 5000)
    c2 = (df['SalarySlab'] != '5k-10k') | ((df['MonthlyIncome'] >= 5000) & (df['MonthlyIncome'] < 10000))
    c3 = (df['SalarySlab'] != '10k-15k') | ((df['MonthlyIncome'] >= 10000) & (df['MonthlyIncome'] < 15000))
    c4 = (df['SalarySlab'] != '15k+') | (df['MonthlyIncome'] >= 15000)
    assert c1.all() and c2.all() and c3.all() and c4.all()
    assert df['SalarySlab'].eq('Upto 5k').mean() >= 0.50
    # ASSERTION_END

    slab_weight = df['SalarySlab'].map({
        'Upto 5k': 0.35,
        '5k-10k': 0.22,
        '10k-15k': 0.12,
        '15k+': 0.05
    }).fillna(0.15)

    # ===== Tenure and career path features =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['YearsAtCompany'] <= df['TotalWorkingYears']).all()
    mask_r = df['YearsInCurrentRole'].notna() & df['YearsAtCompany'].notna()
    mask_m = df['YearsWithCurrManager'].notna() & df['YearsAtCompany'].notna()
    mask_p = df['YearsSinceLastPromotion'].notna() & df['YearsAtCompany'].notna()
    mask_mr = df['YearsWithCurrManager'].notna() & df['YearsInCurrentRole'].notna()
    assert (df.loc[mask_r, 'YearsInCurrentRole'] <= df.loc[mask_r, 'YearsAtCompany']).all()
    assert (df.loc[mask_m, 'YearsWithCurrManager'] <= df.loc[mask_m, 'YearsAtCompany']).all()
    assert (df.loc[mask_p, 'YearsSinceLastPromotion'] <= df.loc[mask_p, 'YearsAtCompany']).all()
    assert (df.loc[mask_mr, 'YearsWithCurrManager'] <= df.loc[mask_mr, 'YearsInCurrentRole']).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    twy_safe = df['TotalWorkingYears'].replace(0, np.nan)
    tenure_ratio = (df['YearsAtCompany'] / twy_safe).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    stagnation_years = df['YearsSinceLastPromotion'].fillna(0)
    role_years = df['YearsInCurrentRole'].fillna(0)
    manager_years = df['YearsWithCurrManager'].fillna(0)
    stagnation_risk = (stagnation_years / (df['YearsAtCompany'].replace(0, 1))).clip(0, 1) * 0.25 + (role_years > 5).astype(int) * 0.10
    manager_change_risk = (manager_years < 1).astype(int) * 0.10

    # ===== Seniority mix logic =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['JobLevel'].isin([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]).all()
    share_l12 = df['JobLevel'].isin([1, 2]).mean()
    share_l5 = (df['JobLevel'] == 5).mean()
    share_l4 = (df['JobLevel'] == 4).mean()
    assert share_l12 >= 0.70
    assert share_l5 <= 0.05
    assert (share_l4 >= 0.05) and (share_l4 <= 0.10)
    # ASSERTION_END

    seniority_weight = df['JobLevel'].map({1: 1.20, 2: 1.0, 3: 0.85, 4: 0.70, 5: 0.60}).astype(float)

    # ===== Satisfaction and work context =====
    sat_components = df[['JobSatisfaction', 'EnvironmentSatisfaction', 'RelationshipSatisfaction', 'WorkLifeBalance']].fillna(3)
    sat_score = (sat_components.mean(axis=1) - 1) / 3.0  # normalized 0..1
    sat_risk = (1 - sat_score) * 0.35

    travel_factor = df['BusinessTravel'].fillna('Non-Travel').replace({'Travel_Frequently': 0.20, 'Travel_Rarely': 0.08, 'TravelRarely': 0.08, 'Non-Travel': 0.00}).astype(float)
    distance_risk = (df['DistanceFromHome'].fillna(0) / 30.0).clip(0, 1) * 0.10

    # ===== Risk model =====
    base_attrition_rate = (df['Attrition'] == 'Yes').mean() if 'Attrition' in df.columns else 0.18
    intercept = np.log(max(base_attrition_rate, 1e-6) / max(1 - base_attrition_rate, 1e-6))

    # Calibrate using workforce mix (relies on age distribution assertions above)
    mid_career_share_by_group = df['AgeGroup'].isin(['26-35', '36-45']).mean()
    intercept += (mid_career_share_by_group - 0.70) * 0.2

    linear_term = (
        intercept
        + age_risk
        + overtime_risk
        + slab_weight
        + stagnation_risk
        + manager_change_risk
        + sat_risk
        + travel_factor
        + distance_risk
    )

    # Seniority adjustment
    linear_term = linear_term * seniority_weight

    risk_score = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-linear_term))

    # Risk banding
    risk_band = pd.cut(risk_score, bins=[-np.inf, 0.33, 0.66, np.inf], labels=['Low', 'Medium', 'High'])

    # ===== Actioning and budgeting =====
    # Budget baseline from salary slab, scaled by risk
    budget_ratio = df['SalarySlab'].map({'Upto 5k': 0.06, '5k-10k': 0.05, '10k-15k': 0.04, '15k+': 0.035}).fillna(0.045)
    # Increase for overtime and low satisfaction
    budget_ratio = budget_ratio + overtime_flag * 0.02 + (sat_score < 0.5).astype(int) * 0.01
    budget_per_employee = (df['MonthlyIncome'].fillna(0) * budget_ratio * risk_score).round(2)

    # Decide action type
    action = np.select(
        [risk_band == 'High', (risk_band == 'Medium') & (overtime_flag == 1), risk_band == 'Medium'],
        ['RetentionBonus', 'WorkloadRebalance', 'ManagerCheckIn'],
        default='Monitor'
    )

    # Prioritize top 20% risk within each department for immediate spend
    dept_rank = df.groupby('Department')['Attrition'].transform(lambda x: np.arange(len(x))) if 'Department' in df.columns else pd.Series(np.zeros(len(df)), index=df.index)
    # Use percentile rank on risk within department
    dept_risk_pct = risk_score.groupby(df['Department']).rank(pct=True, method='first') if 'Department' in df.columns else risk_score.rank(pct=True, method='first')
    spend_flag = (dept_risk_pct >= 0.80)
    allocated_budget = (spend_flag.astype(int) * budget_per_employee).round(2)

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'EmpID': df.get('EmpID', pd.Series(np.arange(len(df)))).astype(str),
        'Department': df.get('Department', pd.Series(['Unknown'] * len(df))),
        'Age': df['Age'],
        'AgeGroup': df['AgeGroup'],
        'JobLevel': df['JobLevel'],
        'SalarySlab': df['SalarySlab'],
        'MonthlyIncome': df['MonthlyIncome'],
        'OverTime': df['OverTime'],
        'RiskScore': risk_score.round(4),
        'RiskBand': risk_band.astype(str),
        'RecommendedAction': action,
        'BudgetSuggested': budget_per_employee,
        'AllocateNow': spend_flag.astype(int),
        'AllocatedBudget': allocated_budget
    })

    out_scores_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'attrition_scores.csv')
    out.to_csv(out_scores_path, index=False)

    # Aggregate budget by department for planning
    dept_budget = out.groupby('Department', dropna=False).agg(
        Headcount=('EmpID', 'count'),
        AllocatedBudget=('AllocatedBudget', 'sum'),
        SuggestedBudget=('BudgetSuggested', 'sum'),
        HighRiskCount=(lambda x: (out.loc[x.index, 'RiskBand'] == 'High').sum())
    ).reset_index()
    dept_budget_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'retention_budget_by_department.csv')
    dept_budget.to_csv(dept_budget_path, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

dataset_record.task_description: Score employee attrition risk monthly to prioritize retention actions and budget.

assumptions.assumption: Age must be between 18 and 65 inclusive.
At least 70% of employees are aged between 26 and 45.
Employees aged 25 or younger comprise no more than 15% of the workforce.
If Age >= 55, then AgeGroup must be '55+'.
At least 50% of employees fall into the 'Upto 5k' SalarySlab.
OverTime must be non-null for all records.
At least 65% of employees have OverTime = 'No'.
No more than 35% of employees have OverTime = 'Yes'.
JobLevel must be an integer between 1 and 5 inclusive.
At least 70% of employees are at JobLevel 1 or 2.
Employees at JobLevel 5 constitute no more than 5% of the workforce.
Employees at JobLevel 4 constitute between 5% and 10% of the workforce.

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Basic type normalization for safety
    numeric_cols = [
        'Age', 'MonthlyIncome', 'YearsAtCompany', 'TotalWorkingYears',
        'YearsSinceLastPromotion', 'YearsWithCurrManager', 'YearsInCurrentRole',
        'JobLevel', 'DistanceFromHome', 'JobSatisfaction', 'EnvironmentSatisfaction',
        'RelationshipSatisfaction', 'WorkLifeBalance'
    ]
    for c in numeric_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')

    # ===== Age-based features =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['Age'] >= 18) & (df['Age'] <= 65)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Piecewise age risk (younger and much older cohorts typically higher risk)
    age_risk = np.select(
        [df['Age'] <= 25, (df['Age'] >= 26) & (df['Age'] <= 35), (df['Age'] >= 36) & (df['Age'] <= 45), (df['Age'] >= 46) & (df['Age'] <= 54), df['Age'] >= 55],
        [0.30, 0.18, 0.20, 0.12, 0.22],
        default=0.18
    )

    # We will rely on AgeGroup for cohort calibration and downstream logic
    # ASSERTION_START
    cond_18_25 = (df['AgeGroup'] != '18-25') | ((df['Age'] >= 18) & (df['Age'] <= 25))
    cond_26_35 = (df['AgeGroup'] != '26-35') | ((df['Age'] >= 26) & (df['Age'] <= 35))
    cond_36_45 = (df['AgeGroup'] != '36-45') | ((df['Age'] >= 36) & (df['Age'] <= 45))
    cond_46_55 = (df['AgeGroup'] != '46-55') | ((df['Age'] >= 46) & (df['Age'] <= 55))
    cond_55_plus = (df['AgeGroup'] != '55+') | (df['Age'] >= 55)
    cond_age_to_group = (df['Age'] < 55) | (df['AgeGroup'] == '55+')
    assert cond_18_25.all() and cond_26_35.all() and cond_36_45.all() and cond_46_55.all() and cond_55_plus.all() and cond_age_to_group.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Distributional constraints used to calibrate intercept
    # ASSERTION_START
    share_mid_age = ((df['Age'] >= 26) & (df['Age'] <= 45)).mean()
    share_young = (df['Age'] <= 25).mean()
    assert share_mid_age >= 0.70
    assert share_young <= 0.15
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Cohort flags from AgeGroup (assumes mapping is correct as asserted above)
    is_mid_career = df['AgeGroup'].isin(['26-35', '36-45']).astype(int)
    is_senior_55p = (df['AgeGroup'] == '55+').astype(int)

    # ===== OverTime features =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['OverTime'].notna().all()
    assert df['OverTime'].isin(['Yes', 'No']).all()
    assert df['OverTime'].eq('No').mean() >= 0.65
    assert df['OverTime'].eq('Yes').mean() <= 0.35
    # ASSERTION_END

    overtime_flag = df['OverTime'].map({'No': 0, 'Yes': 1}).astype(int)
    overtime_risk = overtime_flag * 0.25

    # ===== Compensation and SalarySlab logic =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    c1 = (df['SalarySlab'] != 'Upto 5k') | (df['MonthlyIncome'] < 5000)
    c2 = (df['SalarySlab'] != '5k-10k') | ((df['MonthlyIncome'] >= 5000) & (df['MonthlyIncome'] < 10000))
    c3 = (df['SalarySlab'] != '10k-15k') | ((df['MonthlyIncome'] >= 10000) & (df['MonthlyIncome'] < 15000))
    c4 = (df['SalarySlab'] != '15k+') | (df['MonthlyIncome'] >= 15000)
    assert c1.all() and c2.all() and c3.all() and c4.all()
    assert df['SalarySlab'].eq('Upto 5k').mean() >= 0.50
    # ASSERTION_END

    slab_weight = df['SalarySlab'].map({
        'Upto 5k': 0.35,
        '5k-10k': 0.22,
        '10k-15k': 0.12,
        '15k+': 0.05
    }).fillna(0.15)

    # ===== Tenure and career path features =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['YearsAtCompany'] <= df['TotalWorkingYears']).all()
    mask_r = df['YearsInCurrentRole'].notna() & df['YearsAtCompany'].notna()
    mask_m = df['YearsWithCurrManager'].notna() & df['YearsAtCompany'].notna()
    mask_p = df['YearsSinceLastPromotion'].notna() & df['YearsAtCompany'].notna()
    mask_mr = df['YearsWithCurrManager'].notna() & df['YearsInCurrentRole'].notna()
    assert (df.loc[mask_r, 'YearsInCurrentRole'] <= df.loc[mask_r, 'YearsAtCompany']).all()
    assert (df.loc[mask_m, 'YearsWithCurrManager'] <= df.loc[mask_m, 'YearsAtCompany']).all()
    assert (df.loc[mask_p, 'YearsSinceLastPromotion'] <= df.loc[mask_p, 'YearsAtCompany']).all()
    assert (df.loc[mask_mr, 'YearsWithCurrManager'] <= df.loc[mask_mr, 'YearsInCurrentRole']).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    twy_safe = df['TotalWorkingYears'].replace(0, np.nan)
    tenure_ratio = (df['YearsAtCompany'] / twy_safe).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    stagnation_years = df['YearsSinceLastPromotion'].fillna(0)
    role_years = df['YearsInCurrentRole'].fillna(0)
    manager_years = df['YearsWithCurrManager'].fillna(0)
    stagnation_risk = (stagnation_years / (df['YearsAtCompany'].replace(0, 1))).clip(0, 1) * 0.25 + (role_years > 5).astype(int) * 0.10
    manager_change_risk = (manager_years < 1).astype(int) * 0.10

    # ===== Seniority mix logic =====
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['JobLevel'].isin([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]).all()
    share_l12 = df['JobLevel'].isin([1, 2]).mean()
    share_l5 = (df['JobLevel'] == 5).mean()
    share_l4 = (df['JobLevel'] == 4).mean()
    assert share_l12 >= 0.70
    assert share_l5 <= 0.05
    assert (share_l4 >= 0.05) and (share_l4 <= 0.10)
    # ASSERTION_END

    seniority_weight = df['JobLevel'].map({1: 1.20, 2: 1.0, 3: 0.85, 4: 0.70, 5: 0.60}).astype(float)

    # ===== Satisfaction and work context =====
    sat_components = df[['JobSatisfaction', 'EnvironmentSatisfaction', 'RelationshipSatisfaction', 'WorkLifeBalance']].fillna(3)
    sat_score = (sat_components.mean(axis=1) - 1) / 3.0  # normalized 0..1
    sat_risk = (1 - sat_score) * 0.35

    travel_factor = df['BusinessTravel'].fillna('Non-Travel').replace({'Travel_Frequently': 0.20, 'Travel_Rarely': 0.08, 'TravelRarely': 0.08, 'Non-Travel': 0.00}).astype(float)
    distance_risk = (df['DistanceFromHome'].fillna(0) / 30.0).clip(0, 1) * 0.10

    # ===== Risk model =====
    base_attrition_rate = (df['Attrition'] == 'Yes').mean() if 'Attrition' in df.columns else 0.18
    intercept = np.log(max(base_attrition_rate, 1e-6) / max(1 - base_attrition_rate, 1e-6))

    # Calibrate using workforce mix (relies on age distribution assertions above)
    mid_career_share_by_group = df['AgeGroup'].isin(['26-35', '36-45']).mean()
    intercept += (mid_career_share_by_group - 0.70) * 0.2

    linear_term = (
        intercept
        + age_risk
        + overtime_risk
        + slab_weight
        + stagnation_risk
        + manager_change_risk
        + sat_risk
        + travel_factor
        + distance_risk
    )

    # Seniority adjustment
    linear_term = linear_term * seniority_weight

    risk_score = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-linear_term))

    # Risk banding
    risk_band = pd.cut(risk_score, bins=[-np.inf, 0.33, 0.66, np.inf], labels=['Low', 'Medium', 'High'])

    # ===== Actioning and budgeting =====
    # Budget baseline from salary slab, scaled by risk
    budget_ratio = df['SalarySlab'].map({'Upto 5k': 0.06, '5k-10k': 0.05, '10k-15k': 0.04, '15k+': 0.035}).fillna(0.045)
    # Increase for overtime and low satisfaction
    budget_ratio = budget_ratio + overtime_flag * 0.02 + (sat_score < 0.5).astype(int) * 0.01
    budget_per_employee = (df['MonthlyIncome'].fillna(0) * budget_ratio * risk_score).round(2)

    # Decide action type
    action = np.select(
        [risk_band == 'High', (risk_band == 'Medium') & (overtime_flag == 1), risk_band == 'Medium'],
        ['RetentionBonus', 'WorkloadRebalance', 'ManagerCheckIn'],
        default='Monitor'
    )

    # Prioritize top 20% risk within each department for immediate spend
    dept_rank = df.groupby('Department')['Attrition'].transform(lambda x: np.arange(len(x))) if 'Department' in df.columns else pd.Series(np.zeros(len(df)), index=df.index)
    # Use percentile rank on risk within department
    dept_risk_pct = risk_score.groupby(df['Department']).rank(pct=True, method='first') if 'Department' in df.columns else risk_score.rank(pct=True, method='first')
    spend_flag = (dept_risk_pct >= 0.80)
    allocated_budget = (spend_flag.astype(int) * budget_per_employee).round(2)

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'EmpID': df.get('EmpID', pd.Series(np.arange(len(df)))).astype(str),
        'Department': df.get('Department', pd.Series(['Unknown'] * len(df))),
        'Age': df['Age'],
        'AgeGroup': df['AgeGroup'],
        'JobLevel': df['JobLevel'],
        'SalarySlab': df['SalarySlab'],
        'MonthlyIncome': df['MonthlyIncome'],
        'OverTime': df['OverTime'],
        'RiskScore': risk_score.round(4),
        'RiskBand': risk_band.astype(str),
        'RecommendedAction': action,
        'BudgetSuggested': budget_per_employee,
        'AllocateNow': spend_flag.astype(int),
        'AllocatedBudget': allocated_budget
    })

    out_scores_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'attrition_scores.csv')
    out.to_csv(out_scores_path, index=False)

    # Aggregate budget by department for planning
    dept_budget = out.groupby('Department', dropna=False).agg(
        Headcount=('EmpID', 'count'),
        AllocatedBudget=('AllocatedBudget', 'sum'),
        SuggestedBudget=('BudgetSuggested', 'sum'),
        HighRiskCount=(lambda x: (out.loc[x.index, 'RiskBand'] == 'High').sum())
    ).reset_index()
    dept_budget_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'retention_budget_by_department.csv')
    dept_budget.to_csv(dept_budget_path, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
